# ATSense AI Disclosure

ATSense is an AI-powered resume optimization platform designed to help job seekers bypass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

## Key Features
- AI-driven resume tailoring
- Real-time ATS match scoring
- Semantic keyword optimization
- Expert career advice generation

## Technology Stack
- LLM: GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- Frontend: React / Vite
- Backend: Laravel

## Authors
- Chief Product Officer: Aneesh Ajithkumar
- Editorial Team: ATSense Career Strategists
